main.description: An owner-defined role for one reading list, written in the list owner's repo inside the list space. The record key is a slug of `name`, so renaming is create-new plus delete-old. The three built-ins (Owner, Moderator, Member) exist without a record; `Owner` can never have one.

name.description: Display name. Immutable for the life of the record.

permissions.description: Permission keys from the list catalogue.

rank.description: Ordering for management. 100 is the owner's alone.
